Name: The Dreamer
Description: You may cheat. You will be punished if caught. Unlimited use.
Note: There are many ways to cheat.

Name: The Believer
Description: This character does not have any ability. However, you believe in yourself, and that's all that matters.
Note: This character does not do anything special.

Name: The Cat
Description: When it's your turn. You may click on a revealed card to flip it face down or change the direction of the game. Unlimited use.
Note: The player may click on a revealed card (card facing up) in the player table and make it face down. The reverse card flip animation will play and the resulting effect will be visible to everyone.

Name: The Confused
Description: Jacks now also function as Jokers.
Note: For The Confused, Jacks count as wild trump cards when checking plays and BS, but they still remain Jacks for 4-of-a-kind scoring and do not count toward the Reverse Rule. This character will not be available if the game does not have Jacks in the deck.

Name: The Deranged
Description: Whenever you get a point, remove 2 cards in hand of your choice from the game. Unlimited use.
Note: The player can also choose not to remove any cards in hand.

Name: The Foreigner
Description: When you pass, you may add a card from outside of the game to your hand. Unlimited use.
Note: That is, the player may add any card of their wish, including a joker, regardless of what cards are currently in the game right now.

Name: The Grandmaster
Description: You may call BS on anyone. One use only.
Note: The player may call BS on any player that has Played in their last turn. That is, the target player must have hidden play in front of them.

Name: The Invisible Hand
Description: New action: Manipulate As a starting player, you may choose to decide the rank, the direction, and the player to start the round with. Unlimited use.
Note: Timing: when the player is the starting player and it is the player's first turn of the round. After used that player will become the starting player. The chosen player may not pass or decide the trump rank.

Name: The Philanthropist
Description: If you are the starting player, you may declare to use this ability and play 3 cards on any number of your turns that round. One use only.
Note: This ability may be used on any of the player's turn as long as they are the starting player. Once this ability is used, the player gain the ability to play 3 cards at a time on any turn of that round.

Name: The Privileged
Description: By default, you are always the starting player, unless another character's ability says otherwise. +1 point after leaving the game.
Note: If a player has this character then they will always be a starting player. If this contradicts another character's ability, then follow the other character's ability.

Name: The Rogue
Description: At the start of a round, if every card in your hand is of the suit Club. You may show your hand to everyone, and become the starting player. Unlimited use.

Name: The Speedrunner
Description: If you are the first to leave the game and you have exactly 2 points, you have 0 points instead.

Name: The Spy
Description: When it's your turn, you reveal only one card of your last played hand if there is at least 2 hidden cards in front of you. Unlimited use.
Note: This ability is always active and will always trigger if the player played at least 2 cards on their last turn. The card to be revealed is random.

Name: The Streamer
Description: If you leave the game without ever passing, lose 2 points.
Note: Negative number of points is possible.

Name: The Pacifist
Description: If you leave the game without ever calling BS, lose one point.
Note: Negative number of points is possible.

Name: The Drunkard
Description: "Whenever you decide to play card(s)
Note: you may play random card(s). If you have always played randomly
column5: "There should be an new action called Play Random with a drop down next to the button to select the number of cards to play randomly. If the player has always used Play Random to play their cards
column6: then they will lose 3 points after leaving the game. If the player has used the normal Play action at least once
column7: then they will not lose points after leaving the game."

Name: The Pawn
Description: "New Action: En Passsant. If your previous non passing player played two cards in a turn. You may call BS on the previous non passing player of that player. Unlimited use."
Note: "The enpassant action is only available if the previous non passing player played two cards in a turn and there needs to be another previous non passing player before that player who played 2 cards for enpassant to be available."

Name: The Contrarian
Description: "When you call BS you always punish the opposite player"
Note: "It's like another layer of reverse rule applied. It stacks with the Reverse Rule rather than overriding it
column4: so a call that triggers both is reversed twice and the default punishment stands. Only the calls this player makes carry it."

Name: The Seeker
Description: "At the start of the game
Note: get one character card of your choice from the entire card pool."

Name: The Nice Guy
Description: "You may not call BS on your immediate previous player. Your immediate next player may not call BS on you!"
Note: "You can still call BS if the BS target is not your immediate previous player"

Name: The Broken
Description: "Remove 1 Rule card at the start of the game."
Note: "The rule card must be removable."

Name: The Prototype
Description: "New Action: Defy: Destroy 1 Heart card in hand and 1 random rule card. This action doesn't end your turn. One use per round."
Note: "Destroy a Rule card means to remove it."

Name: The Mastermind
Description: "New Action: Conspire: Choose another player
Note: see their hand
column4: and play their card(s) instead of using yours. One use per round."
column5: "Conspire commits the turn: once the hand is open there is no cancel
column6: and the only remaining action is a play out of that hand. Pass
column9: and Accuse are all unavailable until it is paid off. The cards leave the target's hand
column10: but the play lands in front of The Mastermind
column11: who is the BS target for it. Only players still in the game and holding at least one card may be chosen
column12: and the action is unavailable when the table has no room left for a play."

Name: The Gambler
Description: "When Reset is called. Everyone forms a poker hand using their card(s) in front. Whoever has the weakest poker hand gets punished and takes all cards."
Note: "This character overrides Call Reset Rule. At the end of the Reset procedure
column4: there will be a punish button at the player's block whose poker hand is the weakest. Whoever calls Reset will need to press that punish button. If there's a tie
column5: there will be multiple punish buttons and the Reset caller can decide."

Name: The Mime
Description: "New action: Mimic: Shapeshift as your next player. 50% chance to swap position with your next player. One use per round."
Note: "The target is fixed: always the next active player in the current direction. The copy covers everything drawn on the block - avatar
column8: and the cards in front - frozen as it stood when Mimic landed
column9: so later plays stack onto the copied pile and count down from the copied hand. That snapshot is what keeps the coin flip unreadable: the turn belongs to the chair
column10: so the acting block loses cards and gains a pile whichever way it fell. The seat swap is permanent; the copy is worn for the rest of the round - The Mime's own later turns do not end it - and comes off when the round ends
column14: or Accuse procedure begins. While it stands the Reveal Rule runs per seat rather than per play: each of the two seats turns the copied cards face up when the turn reaches it
column15: so the pile opens on one seat and then the other instead of on both at once. If the seats swapped
column16: that means the copied player's own cards stay face down on their seat until the turn comes back to them
column17: by which point they are already face up on the other seat. Cards already face up when the copy was taken stay face up on both. No ability is copied
column18: and the table's card counter still shows the true total."

Name: The Clown
Description: "The first play you do each round doesn't end your turn. You can do a different action right after."
Note: "The second action is the ordinary turn action space minus Play: Call BS
column6: or Accuse. There is no separate end-turn action
column7: so Pass is how the kept turn is handed back
column8: and it counts as a pass like any other. Call BS still targets whoever was the previous non-passing player before The Clown's own play
column9: since the play itself would otherwise make them the target. If the kept turn would have no legal action at all - Pass Rule removed
column11: and the table short of its cap - the play simply ends the turn as usual and the round's use goes unspent."

Name: The Thinker
Description: "At the end of your turn
Note: your points update to: 0 if n > 12
column5: and 3n + 1 if n is odd where n is your current points."
